response.sql: SELECT COALESCE(p.bats, '') as bats, COUNT(*) as num_awards, COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM manager_award ma2 INNER JOIN player p2 ON ma2.player_id = p2.player_id) as percentage_share FROM manager_award ma INNER JOIN player p ON ma.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY COALESCE(p.bats, '') ORDER BY bats

assumptions.assumption: "share of the total award records" is expressed as a percentage (multiplied by 100), not as a decimal fraction between 0 and 1

alternatives.interpretation: If "share" means the proportion as a decimal fraction (0-1) rather than a percentage
alternatives.sql: SELECT COALESCE(p.bats, '') as bats, COUNT(*) as num_awards, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM manager_award ma2 INNER JOIN player p2 ON ma2.player_id = p2.player_id) as share FROM manager_award ma INNER JOIN player p ON ma.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY COALESCE(p.bats, '') ORDER BY bats
